verdict.rationale: The official CLI lists a dedicated `batch` command alongside output and scripting support. Multifile extraction runs one extraction over a collection of files, evaluation set runs score a processor against every item in a set, and async mode with polling helpers and webhooks supports production workloads. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of batch command semantics (limits, concurrency, error handling), a bulk API endpoint beyond multifile packages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk processing.
